check(LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_nat_box($box)->value == 4);
check(LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_again(LeanBridge::GenericRecords::NatBoxAgain->new(value => n(4), count => n(1)))->value == 4);
check(LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_text_box(LeanBridge::GenericRecords::TextBox->new(value => $greeting, count => n(0)))->value eq $greeting);
my $left = LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_left(LeanBridge::GenericRecords::LeftBox->new(value => n(5), count => n(2)));
my $right = LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_right(LeanBridge::GenericRecords::RightBox->new(value => n(6), count => n(3)));
check(ref($left) eq 'LeanBridge::GenericRecords::LeftBox' && $left->value == 5);
check(ref($right) eq 'LeanBridge::GenericRecords::RightBox' && $right->count == 3);
my $specialized_boxes = LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_boxes($boxes);
check(@$specialized_boxes == 3 && $specialized_boxes->[2]->value == $huge && @{LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_boxes([])} == 0);
my $specialized_optional = LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_optional_boxes(some($boxes));
check(ref($specialized_optional) eq 'LeanBridge::GenericRecords::Some' && $specialized_optional->value->[2]->value == $huge);
check(!defined LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_optional_boxes(undef));
check(@{LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_optional_boxes(some([]))->value} == 0);
my $specialized_nats = LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_nats([n(0), $huge]);
check(@$specialized_nats == 2 && $specialized_nats->[1] == $huge && @{LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_nats([])} == 0);
check(LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_optional_nat(some($huge))->value == $huge && !defined LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_optional_nat(undef));
check(rejected(sub { LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_left(LeanBridge::GenericRecords::RightBox->new(value => n(5), count => n(2))) }));
check(rejected(sub { LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_boxes([LeanBridge::GenericRecords::NatBoxAgain->new(value => n(1), count => n(0))]) }));
check(rejected(sub { LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_optional_nat(some(n(-1))) }));
check(LeanBridge::GenericRecords::echo_left(LeanBridge::GenericRecords::LeftBox->new(value => n(7), count => n(0)))->value == 7);
